# FC Barcelona

> > Official website of FC Barcelona (Barça), covering football, basketball, and amateur sports including ice hockey and rugby, with ticketing, news, museum tours, and member services.

The site serves as the central digital hub for Futbol Club Barcelona, providing comprehensive information about the club's multiple sports teams competing in La Liga, UEFA Champions League, and other competitions. Features include match schedules, Spotify Camp Nou information, accessibility services compliant with Law 11/2023 and WCAG standards, and member assembly voting portals.

## Key Topics

- FC Barcelona
- Barça
- La Liga
- UEFA Champions League
- Spotify Camp Nou
- Barça Atlètic
- Football
- Basketball
- Ice Hockey
- Rugby
- Match schedules and fixtures
- Tickets and museum tours
- Web accessibility and WCAG compliance
- Member services and General Assembly
- Amateur sports teams

## Club Information

- [Official FC Barcelona Website](https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en): FC Barcelona homepage with tickets, news, and club information

## Amateur Sports Schedules

- [Ice Hockey Schedule](https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/amateur-sports/ice-hockey/schedule): Barça Hockey Gel ice hockey fixtures and match schedule
- [Rugby Schedule](https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/amateur-sports/rugby/schedule): Barça Rugbi rugby fixtures and match calendar

## Member Services

- [Virtual General Assembly Voting](https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/assembly-general-ordinary-virtual-2025): Virtual General Assembly voting portal for FC Barcelona member delegates

## Optional

- [Accessibility Statement (Catalan)](https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/accessibilitat): Accessibility statement per Law 11/2023 and WCAG compliance details
- [Accessibility Statement (English)](https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/accessibility): Web accessibility standards and digital inclusion statement
